commit.message:
DOC: fix broken k-mers link on documentation front page (#2609)

* DOC: fix broken k-mers link on documentation front page

The "k-mers" link in the Biological sequences feature highlight pointed at
skbio.sequence.GrammaredSequence.iter_kmers, which is not a generated API
page and therefore returns 404.

iter_kmers is defined on Sequence, and only a class's own methods get a
standalone generated page: in the autosummary class template, own methods
use :toctree: while inherited ones use autoinherit:: and get no page of
their own. GrammaredSequence only inherits the method, so the target has to
be Sequence.iter_kmers, which resolves correctly.

Verified against the published dev intersphinx inventory: the old target is
absent, the new one resolves to
generated/skbio.sequence.Sequence.iter_kmers.html. Rebuilt the website to
confirm the rendered href changed, and confirmed the new URL returns HTTP
200.

Fixes #2605

* DOC: record the changelog entry under Bug Fixes

The entry is a bug fix, and the contributing guidelines say to describe a
bug fix under the "Bug fixes" section. Renamed the heading from
"Miscellaneous" to "Bug Fixes" to match the sections used by the releases
below (Features / Performance enhancements / Bug Fixes / Miscellaneous).

---------

Co-authored-by: Aniruddha Adak <aniruddhaadak80@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Qiyun Zhu <qiyunzhu@gmail.com>

@@ -4,6 +4,7 @@
 
 ### Bug Fixes
 
+* Fixed a broken link to `Sequence.iter_kmers` in the feature highlights on the documentation front page ([#2605](https://github.com/scikit-bio/scikit-bio/issues/2605)).
 * Fixed a loophole in `Sequence` construction admitting extended ASCII codes (128-255) if supplied as bytes or a uint8 array, despite `Sequence` and downstream operations being built under the assumption of ASCII codes (0-127). By default, construction now validates 7-bit ASCII and copies mutable external storage so later upstream mutation cannot violate this invariant. Added `validate` and NumPy-style tri-state `copy` parameters to let expert callers explicitly skip validation and/or require zero-copy construction. `copy=False` raises if a copy would be required ([#2614](https://github.com/scikit-bio/scikit-bio/pull/2614)).
